tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: background.base. Panel ground and applet popup ground. Text on it: on-bg, on-bg-muted.

tokens.name: bg-component
tokens.usage: background.component.base. Inset wells inside the popup: the traffic graph well, segmented control track.

tokens.name: bg-component-hover
tokens.usage: background.component.hover. Hovered segment or inset control.

tokens.name: bg-component-pressed
tokens.usage: background.component.pressed. Pressed segment or inset control.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: primary.base. Primary container: grouped list sections inside a popup sub-page.

tokens.name: primary-component
tokens.usage: primary.component.base. Controls sitting on primary.

tokens.name: on-bg
tokens.usage: background.on. Default text and symbolic icon colour on bg, bg-component and primary.

tokens.name: on-bg-muted
tokens.usage: palette neutral_7 (dark) / neutral_6 (light). Secondary text: captions, units, adapter type, axis labels on bg and bg-component. Intentional addition: libcosmic has no named muted text role.

tokens.name: on-component
tokens.usage: background.component.on. Text on bg-component controls (unselected segments).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: background.divider. Popup 1px border and full-bleed separators.

tokens.name: component-divider
tokens.usage: background.component.divider. Inset separators between menu rows; traffic-graph grid lines.

tokens.name: small-widget
tokens.usage: background.small_widget. Small chips and badges on bg.

tokens.name: menu-hover
tokens.usage: text_button.hover. Hover fill for applet menu rows and the panel button (AppletMenu / AppletIcon classes).

tokens.name: menu-pressed
tokens.usage: text_button.pressed. Pressed fill for applet menu rows and the panel button.

tokens.name: button
tokens.usage: button.base. Standard (secondary) button fill.

tokens.name: button-hover
tokens.usage: button.hover.

tokens.name: button-pressed
tokens.usage: button.pressed.

tokens.name: on-button
tokens.usage: button.on. Label on standard buttons.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: accent.base. Selected segment, radio dot, toggler on, focus ring, link text. Text in accent reads on bg in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: accent.hover.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: accent.pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: accent.on. Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, follows the user's accent.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: success.base. Connected state text on bg, paired with the word 'Connected'.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: warning.base. Degraded state text on bg (adapter missing, fallback active), always with a label.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: destructive.base. Error text on bg (adapter down, read failure), always with a label.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: success/warning/destructive .on. Text on a filled status chip.

tokens.name: toggler-off
tokens.usage: palette neutral_6 (dark) / neutral_5 (light). Toggler track when off.

tokens.name: toggler-handle
tokens.usage: palette neutral_2. Toggler handle.

tokens.name: net-down
tokens.usage: palette accent_blue. Download series: graph area stroke, down-arrow glyph, readout swatch. Fixed, not tied to the user's accent, so it never collides with net-up.

tokens.name: net-down-fill
tokens.usage: Download area fill under the net-down stroke.

tokens.name: net-up
tokens.usage: palette accent_orange. Upload series: graph line (no fill), up-arrow glyph, readout swatch. Told apart from net-down by line-vs-area, arrow and label, not hue alone.

tokens.name: graph-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal grid lines in the traffic graph.

tokens.name: cpu
tokens.usage: palette accent_indigo. System Monitor CPU series: graph stroke, panel label tint, meter fill. Reads on bg and bg-component.

tokens.name: cpu-fill
tokens.usage: CPU graph area fill.

tokens.name: gpu
tokens.usage: palette accent_purple. GPU series: graph stroke, VRAM meter fill.

tokens.name: gpu-fill
tokens.usage: GPU graph area fill.

tokens.name: mem
tokens.usage: palette accent_green. Memory series: graph stroke, RAM meter fill. Always labelled, never read as 'success'.

tokens.name: mem-fill
tokens.usage: Memory graph area fill.

tokens.name: disk-read
tokens.usage: Disk reads: area + stroke, like network download (data coming in).

tokens.name: disk-read-fill
tokens.usage: Disk read area fill.

tokens.name: disk-write
tokens.usage: Disk writes: line only, like network upload (data going out).

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: Unfilled part of meters (RAM, swap, VRAM, GPU power).

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: shade. Scrim behind modal dialogs; not used in applets.

styles.name: title4
styles.usage: text::title4. Largest size inside an applet popup.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: text::heading. Popup header (adapter name), sub-page title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: text::body. Menu rows, list rows, segment labels.

styles.name: caption-heading
styles.usage: text::caption_heading. Section labels in settings (Adapter, Show in panel).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: text::caption. Adapter type/status, units, axis labels, totals.

styles.name: monotext
styles.usage: text::monotext. Single-line rate in the panel (numbers mode, one direction per line on M+ panels).

styles.name: rate-panel
styles.usage: Two stacked rates in a size S/XS panel (2 × 17 = 34px ≤ 40px bar). caption size in the mono family. Intentional addition.

styles.name: rate-readout
styles.usage: Popup live readouts. title4 metrics in the mono family so digits never shift width. Intentional addition.

styles.name: metric-label
styles.usage: Panel metric label above a value or sparkline (CPU, GPU, RAM, DISK), in the metric colour. Mono so labels share the value column width. Intentional addition.

styles.name: metric-value
styles.usage: Popup section headline value (CPU %, GPU %, RAM used). Mono. Intentional addition.

tokens.name: space-xxs

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between readout columns.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Inset of inset dividers; gap between popup sections.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Menu row horizontal padding (menu_control_padding) and popup content side inset.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: Large section gap.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Unused in applets.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Unused in applets.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: Unused in applets.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: AppletMenu rows (square, full-bleed).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small chips; graph series swatch.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Graph well, segmented control, buttons inside popup.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Applet popup container corners.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Large cards (unused in applets).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Pills: toggler, panel button hover pill, segmented control.
